scripts.host:build: cd ../../packages/solid1 && bun install --no-save && bun run build
scripts.build: bun run host:build && bun run generate:styles && vite build
scripts.build:test: bun run host:build && bun run generate:styles && vite build --config vite.test.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run host:build && bun run source:check && bun run generate:styles && tsc --noEmit
scripts.run: bun run build && bun run start
